Friday the 13th is traditionally considered bad luck, but not for SpaceX.
The recovery of Starship from orbit is clearly a big deal for SpaceX, on one level it's a spectacular demonstration of the technology, the Ship only lost one tile and sustained minimal damage. It may well fly again in the future.
But the proof that SpaceX believes it's moving towards operational Starship missions is that there are currently no Starlink missions on Falcon 9 listed on SpaceX's site.
